tei:div.tei:p: rgya ston rtogs ldan la gdams pa bzhugs so// rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma rgya ston pa la springs pa/ yi ge dar chen mar khu mdog gi rten bcas dang ngag rnams a stag kun dgas 'phrod pa dang*/ khyed khams snyoms ban chung rnams la dbyar gyi ring khrid sogs sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar byas/ da lta gnas chen ti sgro brag dkar gyi sde lnga'i tshogs khang chen mor sleb 'dug pa shin tu sems spro bar gyur/ nged kyang chu tshan khar sleb 'phrod pa byung*/ da lta mtshe'u khar spo ba yod/ skabs don der dgun gyi ring sgrub pa dang bcas bzhugs pa de gnas kyi bcud rang du yong ba dang rten 'brel legs tshogs che ba snang bas cis kyang sdod pa de legs/ rang snang snod bcud 'dzom pa'i sgrub gnas su| |nyams dang rtogs pa'i dge sbyor mdzod// ro gcig du mar 'char ba dang*// mkhyen gnyis rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi bstan pa rgyas pa/ dar ba/ bstan pa gnas pa/ bar chad med pa'i smon lam sogs dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo la mnyam par 'jog pa sogs mdzod/ da lan sgrub pa rgyag pa'i cha rkyen la dmigs nas bu ram mtshon pa gcig mar zho gang*/ nged nub kyi gos rnag gzan chen mo gcig rnams yod/ mi 'gyang par rtsam pa ya gang skur gtong*/ tshogs rdzogs zhing bstan pa la phan par snang bas rtsis lan mdzod/ tshes bcu gsum la chu tshan kha nas bris/// /maṅgalaṃ//
